name: settle-land-hover-latch-scaffold
description: SCAFFOLD, NOT a verified repro. Targets the settle-land airborne-latch fix (commit ea2cc7c3, crates/holtburger-core/src/client/movement/system.rs:281-287,5322-5366 — USE_SETTLE_LAND default-on, LAND_SETTLE_EPS=0.08). The live bug: a router seam-jump/teleport left the wasm client with is_airborne=true and vertical_velocity~=0 while hovering a few cm ABOVE outdoor terrain (z = terrain_z + ~0.08). That precondition is a client-side bookkeeping edge case at a landblock-seam crossing, not something the current capture harness (capture_physics_replay.cjs) can script: its 'phases' vocabulary only holds forward/strafe/turn/jump keys for a tick count, its ONE spawn action is the hardcoded '@telepoi Holtburg' + '@pk pk' sequence (the scenario JSON's own 'spawnCommand' field, see probe-scenario.json, is descriptive only -- capture_physics_replay.cjs never reads it), and there is no phase kind or wasm hook that injects/observes is_airborne or vertical_velocity directly. Do NOT hand-author trace-subject.json rows to fake a pass/fail here -- per project rule (test fixtures use real data), a captured trace must come from an actual live session.
missingCaptureCapability: capture_physics_replay.cjs needs a phase kind (or a scenario-driven spawnCommand) that can trigger, or directly reproduce, an is_airborne=true / vertical_velocity<=0 hover within LAND_SETTLE_EPS of outdoor terrain -- e.g. a scripted landblock-seam crossing at running speed near a LB boundary on a known-flat outdoor LB, repeated across many seam crossings until the latch reproduces, OR a debug hook (would require a new wasm/SessionHandle export, out of scope for this test-only work item) that lets the capture script force the precondition deterministically instead of hunting for it.

Once a capture exists that contains at least one tick where the subject trace shows is_airborne (or the nearest available proxy: onGround=false with near-zero recorded vertical speed and small subsequent position delta) immediately preceding a same-tick or next-tick touchdown, this scaffold's phases/acceptance below can be replaced with the real captured window and the status flipped to VERIFIED.

A cheaper interim signal (does not require reproducing the exact latch): re-run the existing fixtures/physics/probe-scenario.json capture and grep the resulting trace-subject.json for any row where is_airborne/onGround stays false-then-true across more than 1-2 ticks with near-zero horizontal displacement -- if the fix ever regresses, ordinary jump-arc captures should start showing multi-tick airborne dwell at low speed even without a dedicated seam-jump scenario.

phases.description: 60 idle ticks so the player lands cleanly after spawn before the seam-hunt begins.

UNVERIFIED, exploratory only: hold W for 1800 ticks (~30 s at 60 Hz) on Holtburg's outdoor terrain to cross several landblock-seam boundaries at running speed, in case a seam crossing incidentally reproduces the live-diagnosed airborne-latch precondition (is_airborne=true, vertical_velocity~=0, hovering within LAND_SETTLE_EPS of terrain). This is a fishing expedition, not a deterministic repro -- the original bug was diagnosed on the stream rig during ordinary bot navigation, not summoned on demand. A capture run against this phase list may complete with zero latch occurrences; that is an inconclusive result; treat it as SKIP, not PASS, for the settle-land regression question specifically (the existing maxPositionDriftMeters/onGroundMismatchCount acceptance bar it WILL still validate is the general integrator-vs-oracle parity probe-scenario.json already covers).
2 s idle tail so any latched airborne state (if the seam-hunt phase triggered one) has time to show up as a multi-tick is_airborne/onGround=false dwell in the captured trace before the run ends.
